missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Камень' is a masculine noun in the nominative as the subject of 'лежит'. 'Большой' agrees in the masculine, and 'на дороге' is prepositional of location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Камень' is the inanimate accusative direct object of 'бросил', matching the nominative form. 'В воду' shows the accusative of direction.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Камня' is the genitive after 'у' to show whose edge it is. The fleeting vowel drops: камень becomes камн- with the ending -я.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'нет'. 'Камня' is the genitive required by 'нет' to express absence. The fleeting vowel drops again, giving камня.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'из'. 'Из камня' uses the genitive 'камня' after 'из' to show the material. A common pattern for what something is made of.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'по'. 'По камню' uses the dative 'камню' after 'по' to show the surface struck. 'Молотком' is the instrumental of means.
Strategic focus: Accusative after 'о'. 'О камень' uses the accusative 'камень' after 'о' to mean stumbling against something. The inanimate accusative matches the nominative.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'На камне' uses the prepositional 'камне' after 'на' to say where the lizard sat. The fleeting vowel drops in this form too.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Камни' is the nominative plural of 'камень', the subject of 'лежат'. 'Большие' agrees in the plural, and 'на берегу' is prepositional of location.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Камни' is the accusative plural of the inanimate 'камень', matching the nominative plural. 'Красивые' agrees in the plural.
